_about: Public-domain Julius Charles Hare (1795-1855), rector of Herstmonceux and Archdeacon of Lewes, for the Word Hoard: Guesses at Truth (with his brother Augustus William Hare, first and second series), The Victory of Faith (1840), Sermons Preacht in Herstmonceux Church (second volume, 1849), The Mission of the Comforter (1854), Vindication of Luther against his Recent English Assailants (1855), Sermons Preacht on Particular Occasions (1858), and his charges and occasional papers from The Better Prospects of the Church (1840) to The Contest with Rome (1852). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 74 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hare-guesses-at-truth-1: Guesses at truth : by two brothers (London : Taylor and Walton, 1838)
hare-guesses-at-truth-2: Guesses at truth : second series (London : Printed for Taylor and Walton ; Cambridge [Eng.] : Sold by Macmillan, 1848)
hare-better-prospects: The better prospects of the Church : a charge to the clergy of the Archdeaconry of Lewes (London : J.W. Parker ; Cambridge : J. and J.J. Deighton, 1840)
hare-victory-of-faith: The victory of faith, and other sermons (London, G.F. Okeden & Welsh, 1840)
hare-herstmonceux-sermons: Sermons Preacht in Herstmonceux Church, second volume (London: John W. Parker, 1849)
hare-unity-of-church: The unity of the church : a sermon preacht at St. Peter's Church, Brighton, on Thursday, December 10, 1840, at the annual meeting of the Chichester Diocesan Association ; with some introductory remarks on uniformity (London : J.W. Parker, 1845)
hare-means-of-unity: The means of unity : a charge to the clergy of the archdeaconry of Lewes, delivered at the ordinary visitation in 1842; with notes (London : J. W. Parker, 1847)

Parker, 1848)
hare-true-remedy: The true remedy for the evils of the age : a charge to the clergy of the Archdeaconry of Lewes, delivered at the ordinary visitation in 1849 ; with notes, especially on the educational, matrimonial, and baptismal questions (London : J.W. Parker, 1850)
hare-contest-with-rome: The contest with Rome : a charge to the clergy of the archdeaconry of Lewes, delivered at the ordinary visitation in 1851, with notes especially in answer to Dr. Newman's recent lectures (London : John W. Parker, 1852)
